overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: The system detects several manifested mechanisms and localizes them accurately, but its main taxonomy weakness is collapsing perceptual and selective-attention mechanisms into confirmation bias. The gap between mechanism-first and strict scores is substantial at the primary threshold. Lower-confidence findings add framing and the candidate tier adds only a false positive, illustrating a precision-coverage tradeoff.
